title: Gradient clipping and learning rate scheduler (part 1)

cues.en: There are several meta parameters that you can apply to adjust the gradient descent learning process.
cues.zh: 有幾種中介參數，可以用來調整梯度下降的學習過程。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to tell you about two of those gradient Clipping and learning rate scheduler.
cues.zh: 這支影片介紹其中兩種：梯度裁剪與學習率排程器。

cues.en: Those are both fairly simple concepts and they are frequently applied when training very large models.
cues.zh: 兩者概念都相當簡單，在訓練超大型模型時經常使用。

cues.en: On the other hand, these are not techniques that you would need to use for most small or even medium sized deep learning models.
cues.zh: 另一方面，大多數小型，甚至中型深度學習模型，並不需要這些技巧。

cues.en: I will briefly explain the concepts of these two techniques, and then I'll show you how they work in Python, and we will explore some of the options.
cues.zh: 我會簡短解釋概念，再用 Python 示範，探索一些選項。

cues.en: Clipping is a general term used in data science, signal processing, and other data related applications
cues.zh: 裁剪是資料科學、訊號處理，以及其他資料相關應用中的通用術語，

cues.en: where there might be extreme values that can be deleterious to the analyses.
cues.zh: 用來處理可能對分析有害的極端值。

cues.en: Here you see a very simple example.
cues.zh: 這裡是非常簡單的例子。

cues.en: Imagine this left column is a vector of data points.
cues.zh: 假設左邊這一欄是一個資料向量。

cues.en: Clearly 99 is an extreme data value.
cues.zh: 很明顯，99 是極端值。

cues.en: So let's say that we have a clipping threshold of ten.
cues.zh: 假設裁剪門檻是 10。

cues.en: So the idea is that any value in this data set that is greater than ten gets reset to ten.
cues.zh: 資料集中任何大於 10 的值，都重設為 10。

cues.en: This is used to reduce the impact of outliers on statistics, data characteristics, filtering or whatever is the analysis that will be applied.
cues.zh: 這能減少離群值對統計量、資料特性、濾波，或其他分析的影響。

cues.en: Now this slide here is not about gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 這張投影片還不是在談梯度裁剪。

cues.en: This is just the general idea of clipping.
cues.zh: 只是介紹裁剪的一般概念。

cues.en: Specifically with regards to gradient clipping in deep learning training, the idea is that you don't
cues.zh: 具體到深度學習訓練的梯度裁剪，概念是不要

cues.en: want to clip the individual values, but you do want to clip the gradients.
cues.zh: 裁剪個別數值，而是裁剪梯度。

cues.en: Radiance.
cues.zh: 也就是梯度。

cues.en: Remember that the gradients are the derivatives of the loss function with respect to the weights in
cues.zh: 記得，梯度是損失函數相對於模型中

cues.en: the model, and that gradient is used to update the weights scaled by the learning rate.
cues.zh: 權重的導數，會乘上學習率，用來更新權重。

cues.en: So if for some reason the model becomes numerically unstable, perhaps because there are too many very
cues.zh: 如果模型因某種原因數值不穩定，例如太多

cues.en: large numbers that are getting successively multiplied, then the gradient is just going to explode.
cues.zh: 很大的數字連續相乘，梯度就可能爆炸。

cues.en: That can cause catastrophic failure in the model.
cues.zh: 這可能造成模型災難性失敗。

cues.en: So the idea of gradient clipping is to scale down or normalize the gradients, so that the norm of the
cues.zh: 所以，梯度裁剪就是縮小或正規化梯度，讓

cues.en: gradient matrix is some threshold value.
cues.zh: 梯度矩陣的範數達到某個門檻值。

cues.en: In the Python demo, I will show setting this threshold value to one, but that's just a number that
cues.zh: Python 示範會把門檻設成 1，但這只是

cues.en: I'm using for illustration, a gradient magnitude threshold of one is commonly used, but it's not the only value that can be used.
cues.zh: 示範用的數字。梯度大小門檻設為 1 很常見，但不是唯一選擇。

cues.en: Now, the thing about gradient clipping is that the gradient magnitudes really are meaningful for learning.
cues.zh: 不過，梯度大小對學習確實有意義。

cues.en: When the gradient is large, the parameters need to change a lot, and when the gradient is small, the parameters should only change a tiny bit.
cues.zh: 梯度大時，參數需要改變較多；梯度小時，參數就應該只改變一點。

cues.en: So we don't want to just arbitrarily change the gradient norms because that's literally losing valuable information.
cues.zh: 因此，不想任意改變梯度範數，因為那等於丟失有價值的資訊。

cues.en: So that's why gradient clipping actually slows down learning.
cues.zh: 這也是為什麼，梯度裁剪其實會減慢學習。

cues.en: On the other hand, if the gradients keep exploding and the model becomes so numerically unstable that
cues.zh: 但如果梯度一直爆炸，模型數值不穩定到

cues.en: it just fails to learn, then slowing down learning actually is a good thing.
cues.zh: 根本學不下去，那麼減慢學習反而是好事。

cues.en: Here you see a screenshot that I will show and explain in more detail in the code demo, but the idea is that I created a vector of values.
cues.zh: 這張截圖在程式示範會詳細解釋。概念是先建立一個數值向量，

cues.en: And that you see here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: And the norm of the gradient is close to 20.
cues.zh: 它的梯度範數接近 20。

cues.en: Then I applied gradient clipping to that vector.
cues.zh: 然後對這個向量套用梯度裁剪。

cues.en: And now the norm has changed to one because that was the threshold value that I used.
cues.zh: 範數就變成 1，因為我用的門檻是 1。

cues.en: Now when you look at these weight values they look really different.
cues.zh: 看這些權重值，似乎差很多。

cues.en: And of course they are different.
cues.zh: 當然，它們確實不同。

cues.en: But the relations between all of the values is preserved and that you see here.
cues.zh: 但所有數值間的關係都保留下來，這裡可以看到。

cues.en: So the pre clipped values on the x axis and the gradient normed values on the y axis, they correlate with each other perfectly.
cues.zh: x 軸是裁剪前的值，y 軸是梯度正規化後的值，兩者完全相關。

cues.en: So the numerical values have been reduced in this case by around an order of magnitude.
cues.zh: 所以這次數值大約縮小了一個數量級。

cues.en: But that change was just a divisive normalization.
cues.zh: 但這個改變只是除法式的正規化。

cues.en: It's not that we're changing individual gradient values while leaving other gradients the same.
cues.zh: 不是只改變個別梯度值，而讓其他梯度維持不動。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So that is the background of gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 以上是梯度裁剪的背景。

cues.en: Now let me tell you about the learning rate scheduler.
cues.zh: 接著介紹學習率排程器。

cues.en: This is also a fairly simple concept.
cues.zh: 這也是相當簡單的概念。

cues.en: The idea is that normally in when you're training deep learning models, you set the learning rate to be one value throughout all of the training.
cues.zh: 一般訓練深度學習模型時，會把學習率設成一個值，整個訓練過程保持不變。

cues.en: Now, on the one hand, if you use the Adam optimizer, the effective learning rate actually is dynamically
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果使用 Adam 最佳化器，有效學習率其實會根據

cues.en: modified by the recent history of the gradients and the variance of the gradients.
cues.zh: 近期梯度與梯度變異的歷史動態調整。

cues.en: But the learning rate scheduler adds some additional constraints to the maximum possible learning rate.
cues.zh: 學習率排程器則進一步限制最大可能的學習率。

cues.en: And here you see an example of some possibilities for learning rate schedulers.
cues.zh: 這裡是幾種可能的學習率排程範例。

cues.en: The y axis shows the learning rate implemented on each training epoch.
cues.zh: y 軸顯示每個訓練週期使用的學習率。

cues.en: And yeah, without actually adjusting the learning rate scheduler, this would all just be a boring flat horizontal line all the way through training.
cues.zh: 如果不調整學習率排程器，整個訓練就只會是一條無聊的水平線。

cues.en: But here in the scheduler, I have imposed a warm up phase, which means that the learning rate starts
cues.zh: 這裡的排程包含暖身階段，表示學習率

cues.en: off at zero or very close to zero, and then it linearly increases after some number of training epochs.
cues.zh: 從零或接近零開始，再隨訓練週期線性增加。

cues.en: In this case it was 20.
cues.zh: 這個例子是 20 個週期。

cues.en: And then I've included a cosine adjustment which is this smooth non-linear decrease that you see here.
cues.zh: 接著加上餘弦調整，就是這裡平滑的非線性下降。

cues.en: This is a one half cycle cosine scheduler.
cues.zh: 這是半個週期的餘弦排程器。

cues.en: And I'll explain and demonstrate in more detail what that means when I switch to code.
cues.zh: 切換到程式時，會更詳細解釋與示範。

cues.en: Now in general, scheduling the learning rate dynamically is another technique that is really not necessary
cues.zh: 一般而言，動態排程學習率，也是小型或中型模型

cues.en: for small or medium sized models, but it does seem to help with large models.
cues.zh: 並非必要，但似乎有助於大型模型的技巧。

cues.en: And again, the idea is to slow down the learning so that it's more numerically stable, even if that means that the learning takes a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 概念同樣是放慢學習，讓數值更穩定，即使訓練因此久一點。

cues.en: Now, I already showed several screenshots of what we will go through in the Python demo.
cues.zh: 我已展示幾張 Python 示範的截圖。

cues.en: So now just let me tell you a little bit more and then I'll switch to code.
cues.zh: 現在再說明一點，就切到程式。

cues.en: First we will have a look at gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 先看梯度裁剪。

cues.en: This is not going to be in a language model, but a super duper simple model with gradient endowed numbers that we can play around with.
cues.zh: 這不是語言模型，而是一個極簡單、帶有梯度數值、可供實驗的模型。

cues.en: So here you see the actual weights from this model and the gradient norm on the lower axis.
cues.zh: 這裡是模型的實際權重，下方座標軸是梯度範數。

cues.en: So the model has two weights.

cues.en: And the goal of the training of the optimization is to get weight zero.
cues.zh: 最佳化訓練的目標，是讓權重 0，

cues.en: So this weight here to be higher than this weight over here.
cues.zh: 也就是這個權重，高於另一個。

cues.en: And here you see the gradient norm from this model before and after clipping to a maximum of one.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示模型梯度範數，以及裁剪到最大值 1 前後的結果。

cues.en: Now this screenshot here actually shows the clipping after gradient descent has already been applied.
cues.zh: 這張截圖其實是在梯度下降已執行之後才裁剪。

cues.en: I will also show you the impact of clipping before gradient descent.
cues.zh: 我也會示範，在梯度下降之前裁剪的影響。

cues.en: And basically what you'll see is that the learning still happens, but it's a little bit slower because we have reduced the precision of the information in the gradient.
cues.zh: 基本上你會看到，仍然會學習，但速度稍慢，因為減少了梯度資訊的精確度。

cues.en: Next I will show several different learning rate schedulers.
cues.zh: 接著示範幾種學習率排程器。

cues.en: And I also showed you one screenshot of an example in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 上一張投影片也展示過其中一個例子。

cues.en: And we'll explore some other examples like this.
cues.zh: 還會探索像這樣的其他例子。

cues.en: So here you see a piecewise linear learning rate scheduler.
cues.zh: 這裡是分段線性的學習率排程器。

cues.en: And you can see that the two weights change the most when the learning rate is high.
cues.zh: 可以看到，學習率高時，兩個權重改變最多。

cues.en: And they don't change that much when the learning rate is lower.
cues.zh: 學習率較低時，就不太改變。

cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Very nice.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.zh: 它們不是唯一能實作學習率排程器的函數，

cues.en: So here we have a simple demo of gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 這裡是簡單的梯度裁剪示範。

cues.en: This is not in a model that we are going to really train.
cues.zh: 不是要真正訓練的模型。

cues.en: And so basically this is just a really simple example that I showed the screenshot of.
cues.zh: 基本上就是投影片截圖中的簡單例子。

cues.en: So you can imagine that these are weights in a model.
cues.zh: 可以把它想像成模型的權重。

cues.zh: 這是損失函數。

cues.en: Now I'm going to show you a very simple example of applying gradient clipping or gradient normalization during learning.
cues.zh: 現在示範在學習時，套用梯度裁剪或梯度正規化的極簡例子。

cues.en: So here I have a model.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個模型。

cues.en: If you have a very vivid imagination, you can imagine this is a language model where we have two tokens.
cues.zh: 如果想像力豐富，可以把它想成只有兩個詞元的語言模型。

cues.en: And what we want the model to do is select the first token.
cues.zh: 我們希望模型選第一個詞元，

cues.en: So the token with index zero.
cues.zh: 也就是索引 0。

cues.en: But the logits actually prefer the second token.
cues.zh: 但 logits 其實偏好第二個詞元。

cues.en: So, uh, so what we need to do in optimization, in, uh, in training is get this value to be large and this value to be small.
cues.zh: 所以最佳化訓練時，要讓這個值變大，另一個值變小。

cues.en: We're going to train for 80 epochs.
cues.zh: 會訓練 80 個週期。

cues.en: Here is the loss function.
cues.zh: 這是損失函數。

cues.en: So uh, any loss.
cues.zh: 也就是 NLLLoss。

cues.en: And here I'm using stochastic gradient descent.
cues.zh: 這裡使用隨機梯度下降。

cues.en: And now for the training loop.
cues.zh: 現在看訓練迴圈。

cues.en: So I'm looping over 80 steps.
cues.zh: 走訪 80 個步驟。

cues.en: First I zero out all the gradients.
cues.zh: 先把所有梯度歸零。

cues.en: Here is where I am calculating the log softmax probabilities of the weights in this matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡計算矩陣權重的 log_softmax 機率。

cues.en: So you can imagine this is like the final logits at the end of the model.
cues.zh: 可以把它想成模型末端的最終 logits。

cues.en: And again what we want is for target uh equals zero to be selected.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，我們要選中 target=0。

cues.en: So the first uh element in this w vector should be higher than the second element.
cues.zh: 所以 w 向量的第一個元素，應該高於第二個。

cues.en: And if it's not then the loss function is going to go crazy.
cues.zh: 否則損失函數就會發狂。

cues.en: It's going to ring alarm bells and that will trigger a, you know, learning and optimization in the model.
cues.zh: 它會敲警鐘，觸發模型的學習與最佳化。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Here is where we calculate the gradient of the loss with respect to the weights.
cues.zh: 這裡計算損失對權重的梯度。

cues.en: And here I grab the actual gradient that is calculated here.
cues.zh: 然後取出實際算出的梯度。

cues.en: And then I optimize.
cues.zh: 接著最佳化。

cues.en: So I adjust the w implement back prop.
cues.zh: 也就是調整 w，實作反向傳播。

cues.en: And here is where I apply the gradient clipping to the weights with a threshold of one.
cues.zh: 這裡對權重的梯度套用裁剪，門檻是 1。

cues.en: And then I just grab the norm of the the gradient again.
cues.zh: 然後再取出梯度的範數。

cues.en: Now notice that this gradient clipping actually happens after I call the optimizer.
cues.zh: 注意，這次梯度裁剪發生在呼叫最佳化器之後。

cues.en: And what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: That means that this gradient clipping has literally zero impact on learning on optimization.
cues.zh: 代表這次裁剪對學習、對最佳化完全沒有影響。

cues.en: And why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because here we've already adjusted the W's.
cues.zh: 因為這裡已經調整過 w。

cues.en: We've adjusted the weights matrix here.
cues.zh: 權重矩陣已更新。

cues.en: I clip the gradients, but then, you know, at the next iteration of training I zero out all of the gradient information.
cues.zh: 雖然裁剪了梯度，但下一次訓練迭代，又會把梯度資訊全部歸零。

cues.en: So this does literally nothing to learning.
cues.zh: 所以它對學習完全沒作用。

cues.en: But the reason why I have it here after learning is so we can visualize the impact of the gradient clipping with and without being included in learning.
cues.zh: 把它放在學習之後，是為了讓我們比較，梯度裁剪是否參與學習時的影響。

cues.en: And that's why this line is commented here.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡這一行先註解掉。

cues.zh: 好，執行所有學習步驟。

cues.en: We don't need to use the GPU here.
cues.zh: 這裡不用 GPU。

cues.en: And now here we see the weights.
cues.zh: 現在看看權重。

cues.en: So remember they start off with a value of 0.2 and minus four.
cues.zh: 記得，一開始的值是 0.2 和負 4。

cues.en: But they need to be swapped.
cues.zh: 但它們需要交換。

cues.en: So weight zero is the target that needs to be higher than weight one.
cues.zh: 也就是權重 0 是目標，必須高於權重 1。

cues.en: So we do see learning taking place.
cues.zh: 可以看到，確實有學習。

cues.en: Uh it's not quite enough to get the desired result.
cues.zh: 還不足以得到期望的結果。

cues.en: That's fine.
cues.zh: 沒關係。

cues.en: I mean, we could have more training epochs.
cues.zh: 可以增加訓練週期，

cues.en: We could increase the learning rate that that's.
cues.zh: 或提高學習率。

cues.en: We don't really care if the learning is successful here.
cues.zh: 這裡不在乎學習是否成功。

cues.en: And notice here you see the gradient norm.
cues.zh: 注意這裡的梯度範數。

cues.en: You see this is the actual gradient norm in green.
cues.zh: 綠色是實際梯度範數。

cues.en: It is larger than one.
cues.zh: 它大於 1。

cues.en: And so therefore when I apply that function to a clip and normalize the gradient magnitudes, it all
cues.zh: 所以套用函數裁剪並正規化梯度大小後，

cues.en: equals one until the actual gradient ends up being less than one, in which case the gradient clipping
cues.zh: 全都會是 1，直到實際梯度低於 1；那時梯度裁剪

cues.en: function does literally nothing because the value of the gradient is below the threshold.
cues.zh: 函數就完全不做任何事，因為梯度值已低於門檻。

cues.zh: 我沒有更動學習率。

cues.zh: 所以不是學習率降低。

cues.en: So all of this difference, the distinction between 1 and 1.4, that is information that the model should be using to adjust the weights.
cues.zh: 例如，1 和 1.4 的差異，就是模型應該用來調整權重的資訊。

cues.en: So in this case we are slowing down learning.

cues.en: As I mentioned in the slides, this kind of clipping is not something you want to apply to simple models or small models or simple clean data sets to learn from.
cues.zh: 如投影片所述，對簡單模型、小型模型，或簡單乾淨的學習資料集，不會想套用這種裁剪。

cues.en: This is really just something that becomes important when you're working with very large models that can be very numerically unstable.
cues.zh: 它主要是在處理可能數值非常不穩定的超大型模型時，才變得重要。
